notes:
Top-line: Riverbend is a mature support SaaS targeting enterprise telco and fintech customers. Primary goal: reduce live-agent escalations by 25% via tight RAG-based deflection and an assistant UI. POC summary: scoped on 10M doc subset (~customer tickets, KB articles, compliance notices).

Requirements (handy fragments):
- Tight latency SLOs: customer-facing suggestion UI must be snappy — CTO: "We need p95 < 400ms for the whole retrieval+rerank path in production; ideal p95 ~200ms."
- Reranking quality: top-5 must hit >90% relevance on our rubric (precision@5 + manual QA).
- Cost sensitivity: finance wants cost per query (embedding + rerank) <= $0.005 at current scale; target $0.002 with caching/quantization.
- Scale: expected steady-state index ~50M documents (tickets + KB + attachments), spike to 150M yearly. Embedding footprint estimated ~1B vectors after history retention.
- Security: VPC/private control plane, KMS key wrap, SSO (SAML), audit log retention 13 months, data residency in US & EU.

POC notes / quotes: "Reranker improved top-5 quality noticeably but doubled p95 — need kernel-level tuning or alternate model selection for first-pass retrieval." — Head of Search.

Open items: legal on data residency clause; confirm throughput for 2000 qps bursts; finalize dedicated GPU sizing and fallback routing policy.
